reviews.text:
My 4 year old mini bernedoodle Grace has gone to pooch patio on and off for almost 3 years! She has boarded, done daycare and it’s the only place I take her in Dallas to be groomed. They also have very flexible weekend options for pickup/drop off for boarding, making it so much easier to plan travel.

She’s always happy and tired out when I pick her up and always looks amazing after a grooming. Prices have gone up over the years but it’s such a trustworthy, quality experience that it is worth it to know your dog is in good hands. I will continue to recommend Pooch Patio!

Thank you for your review Jorge! We were happy to provide services for you and appreciate your patronage!

April 
Owner
Best staff. They genuinely care and that gives me peace of mind.

I have been taking my pup here for a decade, and they consistently have taken fantastic care him. This past boarding stay, I was especially impressed at their level of care & diligence as my pup is now a senior. They made sure he got his meds every 8 hours (first dose being 5am), and took special care of him to make sure he wasn’t outside too long in the heat, carried him if needed, etc.

We also have a younger dog who we bring here, and he LOVES coming to Pooch Patio (our older pup enjoys it too!). He cries when we pull up in the parking lot because he’s so excited to get out of the car and go inside. They have really sweet employees that truly care, and make it a very enjoyable experience for our dogs.

I knew they were always great, but definitely have gone above and beyond.

Thank you Michael for your review! We appreciate your patronage.

April
Owner

We board our two small dogs here whenever we travel. Love all of their suite options and tuck in menu options! Their price is in line with the exceptional service I’m receiving and that they are getting so it’s well worth it! Their communication is really good and I appreciate that so much!
The people are friendly and know me and my dog personally. They take great care of him whenever he gets groomed.
Can you say puuuuuurfect!? A great trustworthy small business owner who rocks at taking care of your fur babies!!

Pooch Patio is the best! Owner April and her team take such good care of your animals-you can totally exhale knowing they’re in great hands. We know we love our animals, sometimes more than the humans in our world 😜 so if you want to know you’re taking them to a great place for grooming or boarding stays, this is your spot! …
I boarded my pup with Pooch Patio and he had a great time. The staff were so sweet to him.

If I could give Pooch Patio more than 5 stars, I would! From the moment we walk in, the staff provides exceptional service and treats our pup like family. Whether it's daycare, boarding, or grooming, they consistently give every dog genuine love, care, and attention. We couldn't recommend them more!

The Pooch Patio has been grooming my Norfolk Terrier, Becket, for years, and we’ve always had a great experience. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with a warm, friendly welcome that sets the tone for the visit.
The customer experience is excellent, and the grooming is consistently top notch. Becket always looks great and is treated with kindness and care.  I highly recommend

I can’t say enough wonderful things about The Pooch Patio! From the moment you walk in, it’s obvious that the staff genuinely loves and cares for every dog. Everyone is friendly, professional, and goes above and beyond to make both pets and their owners feel welcome.

April, the owner, is amazing. Her passion for animals shines through in everything she does, and she’s created a place where you immediately feel comfortable leaving your pet. She genuinely cares about every dog and has built an incredible team that shares her commitment to exceptional care.

My dog is always excited to go and comes home happy, clean, and well cared for. It’s such a relief knowing I can leave my pup somewhere I completely trust. The facility is clean, well-organized, and you can tell the team takes pride in providing exceptional care.

Whether it’s daycare, boarding, or grooming, I wouldn’t take my dog anywhere else. The peace of mind they provide is priceless. Thank you to the entire team for treating my dog like family. Highly recommend The Pooch Patio to anyone looking for the very best care for their furry family member!
Loved this place.  Staff was very friendly, and the facility was super clean.  Will definitely be using them again.
The staff was fabulous, very friendly and helpful.

The Pooch Patio for the win!  Gracie LUVs to go to her spa days and get pampered at the Pooch Patio!  I LUV when wewalk in that we are greeted by name by Sarah the Manager! Super engaged owner, great service, super clean facility, centrally located, great hours of operation. Gracie and I highly recommend the Pooch Patio!  #theprettygirlgracie

I started taking my two  poodle mixes to The Pooch Patio about 5 years ago for daycare and socialization. We began with 1 day a week and was soon up to 3 days because they loved it so much and the staff was incredible, so caring, loving on all of the dogs as if they were their own.
When I picked them up, I noticed some of the dogs getting picked up that had just been groomed and couldn’t believe how darling they looked!
We had a home groomer almost their entire life, but often would have little issues we just dealt with since we enjoyed the convenience.
I decided to give the Pooch Patio  a try since they were already there so often and WOW!! They had the best- sweetest little groom that they had ever had. I was so happy with their new look.
Needless to say, when it came time to board them, it was an easy choice.
While we lost one of our babies 2 years ago,  the other one is still going strong and enjoys every minute she is there! Such a great place with an amazing staff!

My dog Rocky has a lot of energy, and I needed somewhere he could play safely while I was at work. I found The Pooch Patio online and decided to give it a try. The experience has been better than I expected. The staff welcomed Rocky warmly and explained everything clearly during our first visit. He enjoys the play areas and comes home relaxed instead of restless. I also appreciate how clean the facility is and how much attention they give each dog. It is a huge relief knowing Rocky is spending his day somewhere with people who genuinely care.
Rude employees love to pick and choose they will pick which dog to love and which one to not and say mean things about be careful with your fur babies once again employee are not professional

We have been boarding our dog at Pooch Patio for almost 10 years now and I cannot say enough wonderful things about everyone there.

Our pup was a paralyzed and incontinent dachshund and therefore needed additional care with changing diapers and bladder expression. This team not only stepped up to the plate with ease but they treated our dog like their own every single time we dropped her off. They were knowledgeable in what all needed to be done because the owner had dogs with similar conditions so everyone was trained exceptionally well. I felt more comfortable with this team than most vets because they were so sweet to our baby.

I would love to give a huge shoutout to Jodie, April, and Sarah for being constantly in communication with us about our dog, knowing how challenging her condition could be sometimes. Also a special thank you to Lee for being her pet taxi many times to ensure we had our pup home when we landed at the airport after hours.

We are beyond appreciative of everyone at Pooch Patio and highly, highly, highly recommend this team to love your pet as your own.
Friendly staff!

Took my standard poodle here for grooming for the first time and was really impressed with how he turned out. His cut looks great and very clean, honestly like a show dog. They also handled his ears really well, which is usually something he struggles with during grooming. You can tell they pay close attention to the details. I’m really glad this place was recommended to me and I’ll definitely be coming back.

DO NOT LET THE WOMAN “REBECA” CUTS YOUR DOG HAIR. SHE GAVE MY DOG THE UGLIEST HAIRCUT OF HIS LIFE, LEAVING HIM WITH ALMOST NO FUR FOR THIS COLD WEATHER A NORMAL HUMAN-BEING WOULD HAVE THE COMMON SENSE IN THEIR HEAD THAT THE DOG WILL BR COLD AND DEFINITELY WAS BEING MEAN TO MY DOG, HE CAME OUT WITH FRESH TEAR STAINS FROM A FRESH GROOM & HAIRCUT
Thank you for your 5 star review.!

I have been going here for 4 years now for grooming for my Pomsky and they have always done a fantastic job! I’ve jumped around a few times since moving to the suburbs but always finding the drive is worth it! Recently my dog has been diagnosed with cancer and is super fragile right now so I was nervous about grooming but they took extra care of her and got her in and out. The team was so responsive to her needs/instructions and were so general with her. Highly recommend for grooming. We also love boarding and day play when we used to live near by!

Thank you Lauren for your review. We are so happy you had a great experience and we look forward to having you and your dog back again!

April 
Owner

Thank you for your stellar review! We appreciate the love! 


April,  owner

My dog Teddy and I love The Pooch Patio; and they love him too.  He is always so excited to attend doggie daycare and they do a great job with his brushing and haircuts.  He’s a sweet boy and they bring out the best in him.
I've not boarded my dogs here, but I've been for a dog birthday party! It was a lot of fun. Plus they have Three Dog Bakery cakes, little hats, etc!

There’s one particular staff member who constantly made slick, unnecessary comments about my dog — and despite bringing it to their attention before, nothing changed. My dog is sweet, social, and still adjusting after losing his companion, but instead of compassion, we got judgment and attitude. The energy was always off. I don’t trust this place with him anymore, and I wouldn’t recommend anyone bring their fur family here. You and your pet deserve better.
Thank you for your review!

The Pooch Patio is a great place to get your pup washed and styled.  The staff is always so friendly to both me and my dog.  It is clean and everyone greets my dog by his name upon entering/leaving. Great place!
Amazing place to leave your pup! Michelle is amazing and friendly too! Great attitude and showed great care for our pup! She gets a five star too from us!
Don’t answer the phone. Idk if it’s pet friendly

I will never bring my dog to Pooch Patio !! They take you for every penny, I wanted to leave my dog for a overnight stay because I didn't want my dog to be alone at my place while attending a concert with friends, I got a suite and doggy …
We treat everyone's pets like our own. We love them all. Very clean and staff is amazing.
This place always takes care of my sweet fur baby. A bit more expensive than your run of the mill groomer but they always deliver a clean and well quofted puppy dog. A++ would recommend.
Thank you for your review Jason!
It is a very nice friendly place, God bless..ladies and gentlemen this is Rocky,,,very happy after his bath.
Haircuts are on point! My fur baby is always taken care of and looks great! (I’m super picky too). Highly Recommend!
